lines: Your next project starts with a brief and a plan grounded in your codebase.
Setup Home gives you three paths: analyze a workspace, start a new project, or build an AI team.
Each path keeps the work in one place so you can return when you are ready.
Analyze starts by reading the repository and showing what it found.
New project begins with what you want to build and who it serves.
Choose a platform and stack, or let Ptah recommend one.
The proposal workspace shows progress and lets you review the result.
Team builder helps you shape an agent team for this workspace.
You can move between these paths from Setup Home.
Your choices stay available when you leave and return.
Open the path that fits the work you want to do now.
Review the proposal before applying changes.
Setup keeps the plan visible while you make the final call.
